versions.changelog: Cross-platform support: macOS, Linux, and Windows. Updated OS metadata, descriptions, and hardware recommendations.

- Model download and deletion guardrails clarified: models are now only downloaded with explicit user confirmation, never automatically on install.
- Installation instructions updated: model downloads are handled on demand by the router or manually via the dashboard.
- Hardware recommendations are now positioned as optional; users are encouraged to select models that fit available RAM.
- Emphasized that no models are downloaded automatically—pulling requires opt-in or manual action.
- Version bumped to 1.0.2.

- Updated skill name and description to "deepseek-deepseek-coder" with a focus on DeepSeek-Coder.
- No changes to dependencies, usage, features, or documentation content.
- Version remains at 1.0.0; only descriptive and naming details updated.

Initial release: Run DeepSeek models locally across your own fleet with optimized routing and zero cloud costs.

- Supports DeepSeek-V3, V3.1, V3.2, R1, Coder, and Coder-V2 models via ollama-herd
- Automatically routes requests to the best available device using 7-signal scoring
- Enables OpenAI SDK and Ollama API compatibility for DeepSeek deployments
- Provides hardware recommendations for running various DeepSeek model sizes
- Includes fleet features like auto-retry, VRAM-aware fallback, context protection, and request tagging
- Adds dashboard for monitoring model requests, latency, and throughput
- No cloud API, no per-token charges, and keeps all data on your machines
